fact: UNHCR Egypt states 1,100,600 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered with it as of 30 April 2026, Sudanese over three-quarters.

Egypt's Ministry of Interior told all foreign nationals, with the National Committee chair naming refugees and migrants in particular, to register with GAPIN and obtain an ID card before 30 June 2024 or lose access to state services.
Radio Dabanga reports 691,000 Sudanese were registered with UNHCR as of April 2025, holders of the UNHCR Yellow Card as a temporary substitute for residency.
UN Special Procedures experts state 1,098,311 refugees and asylum seekers were registered with UNHCR in Egypt by December 2025, including 834,201 Sudanese.
